scope: development P1-S2 Codex subscription execution only

task_prompt_source.s0_rule: problem_statement bytes normalized only to one terminal newline
task_prompt_source.s1_rule: deterministic wrapper around the same executor-visible projection; no solution, gold, patch, test_patch, hidden admission fields, or LLM planning

codex_jsonl_usage.aggregation: sum every valid turn.completed usage event in one executor invocation

executor_event_semantics.process_nonzero_or_turn_failed_or_error_: PROVIDER_FAILURE unless stronger evidence attributes harness/environment
executor_event_semantics.process_zero_with_candidate_diff: EXECUTOR_CANDIDATE_PRODUCED; final treatment outcome waits for focal+preservation verification
executor_event_semantics.process_zero_without_candidate_diff: candidate absence; deterministic escalation trigger only where preregistered, otherwise candidate failure evidence

cascade_rule: hop 2 may execute only after one preregistered escalation trigger from the frozen WP-07 comparison protocol; no subjective or manual trigger
candidate_artifact: git diff --binary against exact frozen base
cost_rule: all consumed hop and verifier resources remain accounted on solved, failed, or inconclusive runs
